CDD database loading fails with "'int' object is not iterable" error

#### Description

When loading CDD diagnostic database files, the system throws a TypeError with the message "'int' object is not iterable". This affects all CDD file operations including loading files directly and adding CDD files to existing databases.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import cantools

# This will fail
db = cantools.db.load_file('tests/files/cdd/example.cdd', encoding='iso-8859-1')

# This will also fail
db = cantools.db.diagnostics.Database()
db.add_cdd_file('tests/files/cdd/example.cdd', encoding='iso-8859-1')
```

Both operations result in:
```
TypeError: 'int' object is not iterable
```

or 

```
cantools.database.UnsupportedDatabaseFormatError: CDD: "'int' object is not iterable"
```

The issue appears to affect all CDD database operations, preventing any diagnostic database functionality from working properly.
</issue>
